1

Same timing order in both trials兩次試驗的時機排序相同suggestive提示性

After > pre > co for both CH and ACCD. Caveats: the same order arises by chance 1 time in 6, and the 8/15 "after" lead depends on the exclusion rule.CH 與 ACCD 皆為 後處理 > 前處理 > 共處理。但隨機情況下有 1/6 機率出現相同排序，且 8/15 後處理的領先取決於排除規則。

2

9/17 ACCD effects are not significant after correction9/17 ACCD 效應經校正後不顯著underpowered檢定力不足

Only after-treatment is nominally significant (p = 0.028–0.035 across Welch, permutation and Mann–Whitney); Holm p = 0.10. Heat-group CV is 22% vs 5% in 8/15.僅後處理達名目顯著（Welch、置換、Mann–Whitney 檢定 p = 0.028–0.035）；Holm 校正後 p = 0.10。熱處理組變異係數 22%，8/15 僅 5%。

3

Heat doses can't be compared across trials兩次試驗的熱劑量無法比較confound干擾因子

9/17 heat cut growth by 83–86% in every group. 8/15 has no unheated plates, and heat duration isn't recorded in either trial.9/17 熱處理使各組生長減少 83–86%。8/15 沒有未加熱組，兩次試驗也都未記錄加熱時長。

4

No evidence yet that ACCD is heat-specific尚無證據顯示 ACCD 效果專屬於熱逆境hypothesis假說

Without heat ACCD changed growth by +4–7% (n.s.); with heat, +25% for after. Heat × ACCD interaction on log scale: p = 0.19.無熱時 ACCD 使生長變化 +4–7%（不顯著）；有熱時後處理為 +25%。熱 × ACCD 交互作用（對數尺度）p = 0.19。

5

One plate per condition每個條件僅一個培養皿design limit設計限制

Seedlings on one plate share agar, position and contamination, so they are sub-samples, not replicates. All p-values here describe differences between plates, not reproducible treatment effects. The 9/17 no-heat co-treatment plate was lost to fungi (n = 1).同一培養皿的幼苗共用培養基、位置與污染狀況，屬於次樣本而非獨立重複。本頁 p 值僅描述培養皿之間的差異，不代表可重現的處理效應。9/17 無熱共處理培養皿遭真菌污染（n = 1）。

Statistics統計結果

Each treatment is compared with the untreated control in its own family. Holm correction is applied to the Welch p-values.各處理與同組別的未處理對照比較。Holm 校正套用於 Welch p 值。

Methods. Endpoint: ImageJ segmented-line length (mm) past the reference mark. Exclusion: roots under 25% of the group median; this reproduces the 8/15 wiki's "w/o outliers" averages, and the rule was set after seeing the data. Tests: Welch's t, two-sided permutation (10,000 shuffles, seeded), Hedges' g with approximate 95% CI, and percentile bootstrap for % change. Assumptions: Shapiro–Wilk p > 0.05 except 8/15 co (p = 0.015) and 9/17 no-heat after (p = 0.024); the permutation test covers these. Levene p ≥ 0.07 in all families. Limitation: the unit of replication is the plate (n = 1), so p-values are nominal. 方法。指標：ImageJ 分段線測得的參考標記以下長度（mm）。排除規則：低於組中位數 25% 的根；此規則重現 8/15 wiki 的「排除離群值」平均，且是在看到資料後才訂定。檢定：Welch t 檢定、雙尾置換檢定（10,000 次，固定亂數種子）、Hedges' g（近似 95% 信賴區間）、變化百分比採百分位 bootstrap。前提檢查：Shapiro–Wilk p > 0.05，僅 8/15 共處理（p = 0.015）與 9/17 無熱後處理（p = 0.024）除外，由置換檢定涵蓋。各組 Levene p ≥ 0.07。限制：重複單位為培養皿（n = 1），p 值僅為名目值。

Planning規劃

Next: heat-stress soil test, replicate 2下一步：熱逆境土壤試驗第 2 重複

These recommendations draw on gaps found in the two agar trials. Replicate 1 soil data was not reviewed here, so match its protocol wherever it differs.以下建議來自兩次瓊脂試驗發現的問題。此處未檢視土壤第 1 重複的資料，若與其流程不同，請以第 1 重複為準。

1Measure the heat dose量測熱劑量

  • Log soil temperature at root depth in every pot, not air temperature. Soil lags air, and wet soil buffers heat.
  • 記錄每盆根部深度的土壤溫度，而非氣溫。土溫變化落後氣溫，濕土也會緩衝熱量。
  • Record the start and end time, ramp rate, peak and duration (°C·h above 30 °C).
  • 記錄起訖時間、升溫速率、最高溫與持續時間（高於 30 °C 的 °C·h）。
  • Equalize soil moisture before heat (weigh pots), so drought doesn't confound heat.
  • 加熱前統一土壤含水量（秤盆重），避免乾旱與熱效應混淆。
  • Target a 40–60% reduction in control growth. At 86%, there is little left to rescue.
  • 目標使對照組生長下降 40–60%；86% 太嚴重，幾乎沒有可挽救的空間。

2Complete the controls補齊對照組

  • Full 2 × 4 factorial: no heat and heat, each with none, pre, co and after.
  • 完整 2 × 4 因子設計：無熱與有熱，各含 未處理／前／共／後處理。
  • Mock spray (buffer only) on the same days, to separate the agent from spraying and handling.
  • 模擬噴灑（僅緩衝液），於相同日期施作，以區分藥劑本身與噴灑或操作的影響。
  • For ACCD: a heat-inactivated ACCD control. If it's live bacteria, confirm colonization (rhizosphere CFU).
  • ACCD 需加熱失活 ACCD 對照；若為活菌，需確認定殖（根圈 CFU）。
  • Apply the same dose and volume per pot, and record the batch and concentration.
  • 每盆劑量與體積一致，並記錄批號與濃度。

3Replicate the right unit以正確單位重複

  • The pot is the experimental unit. Use ≥ 5 pots per condition, with 3–5 plants per pot.
  • 盆為實驗單位。每條件 ≥ 5 盆，每盆 3–5 株。
  • Sample size: detecting a 25% effect at 80% power needs ~17 independent units per group (~22 with Holm). A 15% effect needs ~44. These figures are based on 9/17 variance; soil is likely noisier.
  • 樣本數：以 80% 檢定力偵測 25% 效應約需每組 17 個獨立單位（Holm 校正後約 22）；15% 效應約需 44。依 9/17 變異估算，土壤變異可能更大。
  • Randomize pot positions in the chamber, block by shelf, and rotate daily.
  • 生長箱內隨機擺放，依層架分區，每日輪換。
  • Run replicate 2 with an identical protocol, so it can be pooled with replicate 1 (replicate as a block).
  • 第 2 重複須與第 1 重複流程一致，以便合併分析（重複作為區集）。

4Pre-specify endpoints預先指定指標

  • Primary: rosette area from top-down photos (fixed camera, scale bar), at day 0 before heat and again after recovery.
  • 主要指標：俯拍蓮座葉面積（固定相機、附比例尺），於加熱前第 0 天與恢復期後各拍攝。
  • Secondary: survival %, shoot and root dry weight (washed roots), chlorophyll or SPAD, and Fv/Fm if available.
  • 次要指標：存活率、地上部與根部乾重（洗根）、葉綠素或 SPAD，若有設備則加 Fv/Fm。
  • Analyze change from baseline per plant, which removes size differences that existed before treatment.
  • 以每株相對基線的變化分析，可消除處理前已存在的大小差異。

5Fix the analysis before the data先定分析，再看資料

  • Write down the exclusion rules before treatment, e.g. plants that haven't germinated or are damaged on day 0.
  • 處理前寫下排除規則，例如第 0 天未發芽或受損的植株。
  • Model: mixed model, with heat × timing as fixed effects and pot as a random effect. Primary contrast: after vs none, under heat.
  • 模型：混合模型，熱 × 時機為固定效應，盆為隨機效應。主要比較：有熱下 後處理 vs 未處理。
  • Report all plants, including dead ones (as survival), so nothing disappears silently.
  • 報告所有植株，包括死亡者（計入存活率），不可默默刪除。

6Data hygiene資料管理

  • Export ImageJ results as CSV; never retype numbers. Have a second person check every table.
  • ImageJ 結果直接匯出 CSV，不要手動重打；每張表由第二人核對。
  • Blind the person measuring: code pots so treatment isn't visible.
  • 測量者盲測：以代碼標示盆，隱藏處理別。
  • Log contamination and pest events per pot, with dates.
  • 逐盆記錄污染或病蟲害事件及日期。
Sources: Root Length Wiki (20260815 CH bio peptide; 20260917 ACCD trial 1) and plate-photo deck (Abby T). Statistics are computed in-page from seedling-level values.資料來源：Root Length Wiki（20260815 CH 胜肽；20260917 ACCD 第 1 次試驗）及培養皿照片簡報（Abby T）。統計由本頁依單株數值即時計算。
